visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown tabby cat walks slowly toward a large, round yellow and white pet bed positioned on a beige circular rug. The setting is a bright, indoor living space featuring minimalist wooden shelving units and a tall Monstera plant in a woven basket. (2) A calico cat suddenly drops from an overhead shelf into the frame, landing near the pet bed and immediately assuming a defensive crouch. The two cats engage in a silent visual standoff, with their eyes locked on each other and ears slightly flattened. (3) The tabby cat pauses momentarily, observing the newcomer, before deciding to retreat. It turns away from the bed and walks toward the left side of the frame, leaving the calico cat alone near the desired sleeping spot. (4) A white cat with black spots is shown peeking from behind the large green leaves of the Monstera plant, watching the calico cat claim the bed. The white cat pounces suddenly, leading to a quick scramble of fur and limbs as the cats scatter. (5) The white cat remains in the foreground, aggressively scratching at the round rug and the edge of the yellow pet bed with its front paws. The background remains a tidy indoor environment with various wooden cat furniture pieces and soft, even lighting throughout.
